comparison.objective: Roll and hold a limp training forearm to expose a wristband, scan it, then restore the arm and scanner.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual limb support plus scanner aiming/triggering within an optical envelope, not dry-mixture flow control or screen agitation.
comparison.success_condition: Requires a valid timed barcode read, gentle forearm motion, and final restoration; candidate requires mass recovery, absolute washer retention, no contamination/loss, screen release, and dwell.
comparison.reason: This tests constrained sensing while maintaining a sprung limb pose, not physical sorting. No material rubric detail is missing.
